data.desc: Scholar Rock is delivering muscle-targeted breakthroughs to transform the treatment of spinal muscular atrophy (SMA) and other rare neuromuscular diseases where muscle atrophy remains a critical unmet need. Following FDA approval in September 2026, Scholar Rock is commercializing ISEMBLYD (apitegromab-mstn) in the U.S. for people living with SMA who are 2 years of age and older and currently receiving a survival motor neuron 2 (SMN2)-targeted treatment. The Company plans to expand access to ISEMBYLD globally, in up to 50 countries worldwide, subject to regulatory approvals. As a global leader in myostatin biology, a field focused on proteins that regulate muscle mass, the biopharmaceutical company is named for the visual resemblance of a scholar rock to protein structures.
